purpose: Grant the API exact notification-template and notification-state persistence privileges, and let the Task Center worker append projection-change Outbox events.
lockImpact: Catalog-only grants take short permission metadata locks and do not rewrite application rows.
dataImpact: No rows are changed. Existing runtime roles gain only the table operations required by the reviewed realtime and notification-template paths.
recovery: Retain privileges during application rollback; append a reviewed revocation migration only after all corresponding API and worker paths are withdrawn.
forwardFix: Append a later globally numbered migration to narrow or revoke privileges. Never rewrite this migration after application.
